odoox_framework.architecture_role: External host application initiating native Razorpay payments
odoox_framework.coupling: Fully decoupled; ULTRON is an external economic control plane layer
odoox_framework.fail_safe_behavior: If ULTRON is offline or unreachable, OdooX payment flows continue uninterrupted

payment_creation_flow.description: Customer checks out on OdooX; Razorpay creates payment order and provides checkout interface.

payment_failure_flow.description: Payment fails at gateway; Razorpay delivers payment.failed webhook; ULTRON validates HMAC, classifies decline taxonomy (hard/soft/unknown), updates customer trust score, and creates RecoveryOpportunity with status 'pending'.

payment_success_flow.description: Customer completes payment via recovery link; Razorpay emits payment_link.paid; AuthoritativeReconciler queries Razorpay API to confirm settlement, updates status to 'recovered', and writes double-entry balanced ledger entry.

webhook_flow.description: Inbound webhook is received, raw body preserved, validated against IP allowlist, timestamp freshness, and HMAC secrets before parsing.

target_v6_model.storage_mechanism: Tenant-scoped credential_reference referencing KMS / encrypted envelope storage
target_v6_model.api_key_format: ul_live_xxxx / ul_test_xxxx with SHA-256 hashed storage in database
target_v6_model.isolation_rules: Secrets never exposed to browser frontend, agent context, LLM prompts, or public API responses

ultron_integration_points.purpose: Target canonical event ingestion API from merchant (OdooX)

rationale: Razorpay webhook payloads and HTTP API event ingestion provide 100% of required failure attributes and customer references.
Settlement truth is governed strictly by Razorpay API verification, never by local merchant database records.
Zero direct DB coupling ensures complete fault isolation; OdooX payments are unaffected if ULTRON is offline.
Eliminating DB access adheres to the principle of least privilege and prevents expanding PCI-DSS audit scope.
